review_notes: I read the whole target file and the definitions it relies on in SchemeProperties/ConnectedComponents.lean. That meant `Scheme.connectedComponentOpen`, `Scheme.mem_connectedComponentOpen` and `Scheme.connectedComponentOpen_mk`. The target file declares no simp lemmas and no simp attributes. It uses only `simpa [zc] using he` once, for a small local goal. The membership lemma `Scheme.mem_connectedComponentOpen` is already `@[simp]`, in the right direction, and the cover proof uses it. `Scheme.connectedComponentOpen_mk` is not simp. It is stated on the coercion to `Set X`, and the connectedness proof applies it with `change` and `rw`. I judged that too speculative to recommend as a simp lemma, because it is only a one-off use and it is defined in another file. The Noetherian locally-connected instance and the other theorems are not simp-shaped. I found no rewrite cycles, competing rules or unwanted expansions. I did not check whether other files in the repository use these lemmas through simp.
